faq.title: Got a question? We've got the answer
faq.subtitle: The most common questions we get from our clients about Special Cards

q0.a: Special Cards is a platform specialized in designing and sending distinctive digital invitations for weddings and occasions. It helps you create invitations easily, send them via WhatsApp and text messages, track attendance statistics, and send automatic reminders.

q1.q: How can I create a new invitation?
q1.a: You can create a new invitation through the Special Cards app. Choose the right number of invitations, add your event details, and invite your guests. The app is available on the App Store and Google Play.

q2.q: Can I add my own custom design?
q2.a: Of course, you can provide us with any custom design of your own.

q3.q: Can I see the details of RSVPs and attendance?
q3.a: Yes, you'll get an overall attendance summary along with a detailed list containing guest names and phone numbers.

q4.q: Can reminders be sent to guests?
q4.a: Yes, Special Cards automatically sends a reminder to all guests one day before the event. You can also send extra reminders whenever needed.

q5.q: What is the compensatory credit system?
q5.a: Compensatory credit means that if a guest declines, you get a free replacement invitation you can use to invite someone else.

q6.q: Can I assign more than one additional host?
q6.a: Yes, you can assign more than one additional host. For example, you can allocate specific invitations to the groom's family, and you'll still see comprehensive statistics across all invitations.

q7.q: Are invitations sent to each guest by their personal name?
q7.a: Yes, the invitation message shows each guest's name personally.

q8.q: Do all invitations reach the recipients?
q8.a: Yes, God willing, all invitations reach recipients whether via WhatsApp or text message.

q9.q: What about guests who don't use WhatsApp?
q9.a: No worries, they'll receive the invitation via text message instead of WhatsApp.

q10.q: Can I invite guests from outside Saudi Arabia?
q10.a: Yes, you can invite guests from anywhere in the world.

q11.q: Is my data safe with Special Cards?
q11.a: The security of your data is our top priority. We use the latest encryption and protection technologies to ensure the privacy of your information and your guests' data. All data is protected and never shared with any third party.

intro.title: Introduction
intro.p1: {{siteName}} is committed to protecting the privacy of the users of its platforms and applications, which include the systems, websites, applications, and all channels, services, and products affiliated with it.
intro.p2: {{siteName}} is committed to collecting and processing personal data in accordance with the provisions of the Saudi Personal Data Protection Law and its implementing regulations issued by the Saudi Data and Artificial Intelligence Authority (SDAIA), and in a manner consistent with best local and international practices in the field of privacy protection.
intro.p3: This policy aims to clarify how personal data is collected and processed, state the legitimate purposes of that processing, and set out data subjects' rights and the means of exercising them, in addition to the security and organizational measures adopted by {{siteName}} to protect data from any unauthorized access, use, or disclosure.

scope.title: Scope of Application
scope.p1: This policy applies to all personal data that {{siteName}} collects or processes from the users of its platforms and applications, whether they are natural or legal persons, inside or outside the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, through any of the following means or channels:
scope.item5: Official communication channels, including, without limitation, WhatsApp messages and text messages.
scope.item6: Any other means or platform that {{siteName}} may adopt in the future to provide its services or products.

definitions.title: Definitions
definitions.p1: For the purposes of this policy, the terms and phrases below shall have the meanings specified opposite each of them:
definitions.def1: Any information relating to a natural or legal person that identifies or could identify them, including, for example, name, ID number, commercial registration number, mobile number, email address, or any other data that can be used to identify the person or entity concerned.
definitions.def2: Any operation performed on personal data, whether automated or manual, including, without limitation, collection, recording, organization, storage, use, disclosure, modification, transmission, retrieval, transfer, or destruction.
definitions.def3: {{siteName}}, as the entity that determines the purposes and means of processing personal data and bears legal responsibility for that data.
definitions.def4: The natural or legal person to whom the personal data processed by {{siteName}} relates.
definitions.def5: Personal data whose disclosure, processing, or circulation entails high risk to the data subject, including, for example, financial data, biometric data, and identity-verification means.

purpose.title: Purpose and Legal Grounds for Collecting Personal Data
purpose.p1: {{siteName}} collects and processes users' personal data when using the platforms or applications in order to achieve the following purposes:
purpose.card1Body: Data is used to activate accounts, carry out registration and payment processes, and enable users to manage and organize occasions and events and obtain products and services.
purpose.card2Body: Data is used to analyze performance and usage in order to improve the services and products provided, develop new features, and ensure the stability and security of the platforms or applications.
purpose.card3Body: Contact data is used to communicate with users regarding their requests or inquiries, or to provide them with technical and technological assistance.
purpose.card4Body: {{siteName}} sends notifications or alerts to users related to the use of services or products, or updates to the relevant terms or policies.
purpose.card5Body: Data may be processed to fulfill regulatory requirements or to meet any legal or organizational obligations issued by the competent authorities in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
purpose.card6Body: Data is used to maintain the security of the platforms or applications and to protect accounts from unlawful use or unauthorized access.

dataTypes.title: Types of Personal Data Collected by {{siteName}}
dataTypes.def1: Includes full name, mobile number, email address, and other contact details.
dataTypes.def2: Includes details of occasions or events, the names of invitees and their contact details, RSVP responses, notes, and the date, time, and locations of occasions and events.
dataTypes.def3: Includes IP address, device type, device number and specifications, operating system, and login data for the platforms and applications and activity logs.
dataTypes.def4: Includes transaction number, payment amount and date, financial service provider and payment channel data, with confirmation that the Company does not retain or store bank or credit card information.
dataTypes.def5: Includes messages, conversations, support requests, and text, audio, or video attachments submitted by the user.
dataTypes.term6: Third-Party Data Provided by the User:
dataTypes.def6: If the user enters data relating to other parties, the processing of this data is carried out based on the user's consent and request, and the user is responsible for obtaining the consent of those parties before providing {{siteName}} with their data.

sharing.title: Sharing Data with External Parties
sharing.p1: {{siteName}} is committed to maintaining the confidentiality of personal data and does not share it with any external party except in the cases specified below:
sharing.def1: Some data is shared with approved service providers to facilitate the provision of certain services or products, under agreements that ensure compliance with confidentiality and data protection.
sharing.def2: Data is shared when there is a legal obligation or an official request issued by a competent governmental or judicial authority.
sharing.def3: Some data related to arranging events and occasions is shared with the relevant parties to the extent necessary to provide the requested services.

protection.title: Protection of Personal Data
protection.p1: {{siteName}} is committed to protecting personal data in accordance with the provisions of the Saudi Personal Data Protection Law and its implementing regulation, by taking the necessary measures to ensure:
protection.item1: The confidentiality of personal data and its protection from any unauthorized access, use, or disclosure.
protection.item2: The integrity of personal data and prevention of its unlawful modification.
protection.item3: Restricting access to personal data so that it is limited to employees and authorized parties within the scope of the need and responsibility established.
protection.item4: Using personal data in a manner consistent with the authorized purpose and safeguarding the rights of individuals and entities in accordance with the adopted policy and the law in force in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

rights.title: Data Subject Rights
rights.p1: {{siteName}} guarantees the data subject the exercise of the legal rights set out in the Saudi Personal Data Protection Law, including the following:
rights.right1Body: Knowing the personal data collected by the platform, its categories, and the purposes associated with its processing.
rights.right2Body: Requesting the modification or correction of any inaccurate or incomplete personal data.
rights.right3Body: Requesting the removal or destruction of their personal data once the purpose of its collection has expired.
rights.right4Body: Withdrawing any previously given consent to the processing of personal data.
rights.right5Title: Restriction of or Objection to Processing
rights.right5Body: Objecting to or restricting the processing of personal data where a legal justification is available.
rights.right6Body: Requesting a copy of personal data in a readable format.

retention.title: Data Retention Period
retention.p1: {{siteName}} retains personal data to achieve the purposes for which it was collected, or as required by the relevant laws and regulations. Data retention continues for as long as it is required to fulfill legal or regulatory obligations, or to protect rights and claims related to the platform or the parties concerned. Users may request the deletion of their personal data, and the request will be carried out in accordance with the adopted procedures and in a manner that does not conflict with any existing legal obligations.

general.title: General Provisions
general.item1Body: By using the {{siteName}} platform, you expressly agree to this privacy policy, including any subsequent amendments made to it. If you do not agree to any of the provisions of this policy, you must stop using the platform immediately.
general.item2Body: {{siteName}} reserves the right to amend the privacy policy in a manner consistent with the laws and regulations in force in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Your continued use of the platform after any amendments are announced constitutes your explicit acceptance of those changes.
general.item3Body: This policy and any disputes arising from its use or interpretation are subject to the laws and regulations of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and jurisdiction shall lie exclusively with the competent courts of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

cancellation.intro: If the client wishes to cancel the occasion or service, the refund of amounts depends on the following cases:
cancellation.beforeHeading: Before invitations begin being sent, or before the service begins being used
cancellation.beforeItem1: The Company is entitled to deduct 10% of the total invoice value, in addition to deducting all services that were not provided to the client.
cancellation.beforeItem2: The amount due — after deductions — will be refunded within a maximum period of 7 days.
cancellation.afterHeading: After invitations begin being sent, or after the service begins being used
cancellation.afterItem1: The Company is entitled to deduct 50% of the total invoice value.
cancellation.afterItem2: The amount due — after deductions — will be refunded within a maximum period of 7 days.
cancellation.weekHeading: One week before the occasion's date, or after the service has been used
cancellation.weekItem1: The client is not entitled to a refund of any amounts paid, and all obligations are considered to remain in effect.

rescheduling.title: Rescheduling Policy
rescheduling.intro: If the client wishes to reschedule the occasion or service, the rescheduling process is subject to the following cases:
rescheduling.beforeHeading: Before invitations begin being sent, or before the service begins being used
rescheduling.beforeItem1: The client is allowed to reschedule once only, with no additional fees.
rescheduling.afterHeading: After invitations begin being sent, or after the service begins being used
rescheduling.afterItem1: The client is allowed to reschedule once only, for an additional fee of 30% of the total invoice value.
rescheduling.weekHeading: One week before the occasion's date, or after the service has been used
rescheduling.weekItem1: The client is allowed to reschedule once only, for an additional fee of 50% of the total invoice value.

note.label: Note
note.body: This policy applies to all packages of the invitation management service, electronic services, and additional services of all kinds.
